# 🗺️ Federation Map

**Topology:** a guide hub + sibling sites. `guide.agentprivacy.ai` is the index/front-door; each canon source is projected into its own forkable subdomain wiki. Local mirrors (`*.localhost`) are built first; going public swaps `localhost` for the agentprivacy domain with no structural change.

## Source → site

| Source repo (git · upstream) | Sibling site | Content | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| `agentprivacy-skills` | skill.guide.agentprivacy.ai → mitch.skill.fedwiki.club | personas + role/privacy-layer/meta/wikis | LIVE (163) |
| `cityofmages/tomes` | tomes.guide.agentprivacy.ai | tome acts (I–X), cast, specs, bestiary, invitations | LIVE (169) |
| `agentprivacy-docs` | research.guide.agentprivacy.ai | conjectures C1–C96, PVM v6 spec + papers | LIVE (199) |
| `spellweb/src/data` | atlas.guide.agentprivacy.ai | graph nodes + edges + tileglyph tiles | LIVE (806) |
| `mitchuski/myterms` | myterms.guide.agentprivacy.ai | MyTerms / IEEE 7012-2025 agreement-layer kit — alliance application + integration plan + the two familiars | LIVE |
| `mitchuski/kyra_gatehouse` | kyra.guide.agentprivacy.ai | KYRA Gate — the KY-A checkpoint: lineup guide + engine papers | LIVE |
| `~/transmediale` (no repo; zip-distributed) | transmediale.guide.agentprivacy.ai | the improbable engine — lattice-torus instrument + run-your-own-grid | LIVE |
| `~/field_guide_privacymage` (field farm → embassy Pis) | fieldguide.guide.agentprivacy.ai | the Field Guide trust overlay — counter-spec rulings, 124 properties, the Meet rite, the assets workbench | LIVE (23) |
| `~/codex_mage` | codexmage.guide.agentprivacy.ai | source-linked observer map — Star model, consolidation, runtime layers, queue, and current core-artefact observation | LIVE (9) |
| `agentprivacy_master` | (indexed by the guide) | the /guide "Read it & Fork it" door | wiring |

## How they federate

Each site is a real farm host (`~/.wiki/<host>/` — pages + `assets/<slug>/` + `status/owner.json`), served by `wiki --data ~/.wiki --port 3030 --farm`. Pages cross-link across sites through the FedWiki neighborhood, and the cross-links mirror the **spellweb knowledge graph** edges (`defines`, `proves`, `narrates`, `inhabits`, `kin_to`, …) — so the wiki web *is* the canonical relationship graph.

---
